description: Use this after each user message to save information that may be useful to remember, even if the user does not say 'remember this': specific facts, preferences, decisions, names, dates, project details, commitments, and important corrections. Save all useful details, one concise, self-contained memory per call, preserving exact wording, numbers, identifiers, and context when precision matters. Avoid duplicates and distinguish facts from inferences. There is no update tool: to supersede outdated information, save the corrected fact and say what it replaces. Never save passwords, API keys, tokens or other credentials, payment card numbers, government ID numbers, or protected health information. If MemoryRouter hooks already save completed turns in this host, do not save the turn again. Writes only to the user's OAuth-selected vault; the host may ask the user to confirm each save.

content.description: One concise, self-contained fact, preference, decision, commitment, correction, or outcome. Preserve exact wording, numbers, and identifiers when precision matters.

tags.description: Optional short category labels. These are preserved as provenance text until structured tags ship.
